items.title: nvidia's auto-ontology holds the top spot with 2,679 stars
items.summary:
nvidia's python framework builds semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data so query generation is deterministic instead of guessed.
it is at 7,588 total stars, up 860 since last night, and the repo was last pushed yesterday at 14:45 utc.

items.title: agent-desktop adds 2,173 stars for computer use without pixels
items.summary:
vercel's rust cli lets an agent drive a desktop through the accessibility tree instead of reading screenshots.
total stars went from 16,396 to 17,071 overnight and the repo was pushed at 01:21 utc today.

items.title: mattpocock's skills repo keeps 2,071 stars a day
items.summary:
the readme says 'skills for real engineers', taken straight from his .agents directory.
it is the biggest repo on the chart at 315,458 stars and added 871 of them since last night.

items.title: scrapling holds 1,655 stars as scraping demand persists
items.summary:
python framework built to handle one request or a full crawl, with anti-bot handling included rather than bolted on.
it sits at 98,148 stars, 551 more than last night, and the author pushed at 18:01 utc yesterday.

items.title: discimage studio enters the chart with 984 stars
items.summary:
a c# disc-image tool, the only .net entry on today's list, and it ships with no description on github.
it is at 7,368 total stars, 272 more than last night, and the repo was pushed at 17:24 utc yesterday.

items.title: floci keeps 779 stars as a free local aws emulator
items.summary:
a java aws emulator pitched as 'light, fluffy, and always free' for running cloud services on a laptop.
it is at 30,492 stars, 353 more than last night, with a push at 21:02 utc.

items.title: scenario-labs' skills repo arrives with 667 stars
items.summary:
python skills that let an agent call image, video, audio and 3d models without wiring each provider api.
first appearance on the chart at 3,143 total stars, pushed at 23:21 utc yesterday.

items.title: gstack holds 612 stars for garry tan's claude code setup
items.summary:
23 opinionated tools that reproduce his ceo, designer and engineer agents, packaged as a single install.
140,027 total stars now, 283 more overnight, and the repo was pushed at 03:30 utc this morning.

items.title: trump says iran sent a nuclear proposal as he weighs more strikes
items.summary:
trump told reporters iran had sent a proposal through mediators on its nuclear programme, and that 'they're not doing anything without our approval'.
he added he would 'rather not destroy the rest of the country, if possible, but maybe i'll have to' and that reporters would 'know soon enough'.
items.change: new: trump's first extended remarks on iran since the midterms, putting a nuclear proposal and an explicit strike threat in the same answer.

items.title: herzog will hand eisenkot the mandate on sunday
items.summary:
after a week of consultations herzog ended with 67 seats behind eisenkot, the 48-seat opposition bloc plus the arab parties' 19, and set the handover for sunday.
he will meet party leaders privately over the weekend, and liberman has dropped his veto on sitting with the haredi parties.
items.change: herzog named sunday for the handover and liberman dropped his veto on haredi partners, the first real movement in the coalition arithmetic.

items.title: turkey's parliament ratifies the mecca defence pact
items.summary:
lawmakers approved the saudi-pakistan-turkey agreement 279-119, with 398 of 592 members voting.
article 2 commits all three to 'immediately provide assistance' if one is attacked, mirroring nato's article 5 and putting nato's second-largest military behind riyadh.
items.change: new: ankara's ratification turns august's signed pact into a commitment, with a collective-defence clause now live.

items.title: five tankers and a tugboat burn in hormuz, iran's army says
items.summary:
the irgc told fars that a large tanker hit a mine on the 'illegal passageway' south of the strait and burned, and that a second supertanker and the tug sent to help it also caught fire.
the army then said three more tankers hit mines early thursday, taking the count to five tankers damaged in one night.
items.change: the count rose from three vessels to five tankers plus a tugboat across the irgc and army statements.

items.title: rezaei delivers khamenei's letter to putin in moscow
items.summary:
iran's security council chief met putin on thursday and said they discussed post-war security arrangements, energy cooperation and russian gas pipelines to iran.
he repeated that tehran has seven conditions for washington and will neither open hormuz nor negotiate until they are met.
items.change: the meeting happened and produced a readout; last night's build only had rezaei arriving with the message.

items.title: araghchi calls turkish and emirati ministers as mediation widens
items.summary:
iran's foreign minister spoke to his turkish and emirati counterparts about the us-iran talks and regional stability, per a turkish ministry source and his own telegram.
the calls came as ankara and tehran traded accounts of a turkish soldier killed at their border this week.
items.change: new: the gulf track is now turkey and the uae alongside qatar, where last night's build had only riyadh on the phone.

items.title: yemen's government tightens customs to squeeze houthi finances
items.summary:
new rules make foreign-exchange transfers conditional on proof that import charges are paid in full, aimed at the parallel trade that funds the houthis.
importers say the paperwork adds cost in a country where basic goods already trade at black-market prices.
items.change: new: the government is opening an economic front after sacking ministers last week over the stalled counteroffensive.

items.title: us held secret talks with iran on deporting iranians, court files show
items.summary:
unsealed court documents show the administration told a judge as recently as mid-october it had plans to deport iranians through an unnamed third country.
the judge ordered 24 hours' notice before any deportation to iran itself and five days' written notice before any other destination.
items.change: new: a channel between washington and tehran that is running while the war continues.

items.title: nasdaq falls 5.5% in the worst day since april 2025
items.summary:
the nasdaq closed at 24,315, down 5.52% and more than 10% off its peak, while the s&p lost 4.36% to 7,353.73 and the dow lost 1,833 points to 51,523.
the magnificent seven shed over $1trn of market value, nvidia about $440bn of it, and the vix jumped 11.57 points to 28.18.
items.change: the selloff deepened into the close: last night's 16:10z snapshot had the s&p at -3.27%, it finished at -4.36%.

items.title: futures steady while asia's chip stocks take the hit
items.summary:
s&p futures were up 0.21% and nasdaq 100 futures up 1.03% at 03:20 utc, after the cash session had closed.
asia did the falling instead: the nikkei dropped 5.27%, sk hynix 8% and samsung 7%, with foxconn down 9.4%.

items.title: october payrolls land at 16:30 riyadh with 59,000 expected
items.summary:
the dow jones consensus is a 59,000 gain in nonfarm payrolls with unemployment steady at 4.2%, per cnbc's preview.
the same 13:30 utc release carries average hourly earnings, forecast up 0.3% on the month and 2.9% on the year.

items.title: berkshire, vistra and moderna lead friday's earnings
items.summary:
berkshire hathaway, vistra, moderna, humana, enbridge and brookfield asset management are on the calendar.
humana is forecast to swing to a $1.03 loss from $3.24 of profit a year ago, and moderna's loss to widen to $1.10 from $0.51.

items.title: oil holds above $90 with brent back near $100
items.summary:
wti for december was $91.31, up 0.87%, and brent for january $99.55, up 1.28%, at 03:20 utc.
the move extends thursday's reversal, when crude rose while equities sold off and hormuz traffic stayed restricted.

items.title: gold slips 1.3% as the dollar firms
items.summary:
comex december gold was $4,059.70, down 1.31%, against a dollar index of 101.585, up 0.16%.
the 10-year was 4.847% and the 2-year 4.482%, both barely changed on the day.

items.title: tesla and spacex lose $420bn in two days
items.summary:
tesla fell about 9% and spacex about 11% on thursday as investors priced in congressional probes and tighter rules after the democratic sweep.
the two-day drop tops $420bn, and his wealth, above $1trn after spacex's june ipo, is now below $800bn.

items.title: democrats open with a call for a data-center moratorium
items.summary:
sanders posted 'national data center moratorium now' after referendums passed in several localities, with ansari and casar pushing similar lines.
cnbc's voter survey found 56% called ai and data centres a crucial or major factor, and 65% of those voted democratic.

items.title: palace away on sunday in the last game before the break
items.summary:
liverpool go to selhurst park for a 2pm gmt kick-off, 5pm in riyadh, with tony harrington refereeing and mat wilkes and steve meredith on the lines.
a third straight defeat going into the international break is the scenario iraola is trying to avoid.
items.change: the officials are confirmed and the kick-off is 2pm gmt; last night's build had the fixture without a referee.

items.title: iraola has a nyoni fitness call to make for palace
items.summary:
the echo's projected xi has araujo back at right-back and van dijk alongside jacquet, but asks whether nyoni can start a third game in a week.
iraola said on tuesday that young players are 'already ready', and nyoni was the best player on the pitch in istanbul before coming off.

items.title: van dijk: 'we cannot lose in the manner we did'
items.summary:
liverpool led twice in istanbul and lost 3-2 to muriqi's header, their first champions league defeat of the season.
van dijk said the squad should be disappointed and that the manner of the loss, not the effort, was the problem.
items.change: the captain's verdict is in: van dijk called the manner of the collapse the issue, after iraola had called the goals cheap and messy.

items.title: araujo's £47m option looks likelier after an agent meeting
items.summary:
the echo reports araujo's new agent met a barcelona club chief, and that barcelona are looking at leipzig's castello lukeba as a replacement.
liverpool's clause is a £47m option rather than an obligation, and the player still has to agree to the move.
items.change: barcelona looking at a replacement is the new detail; last night's build only had the £47m option looking likelier.

meta.reliability: medium - echo reporting a sport claim

items.title: gravenberch still out with a fractured heel
items.summary:
the midfielder has a heel fracture and missed istanbul, and no return date has been published.
nyoni has started the last two games in his absence, and the shape for palace is still open.

items.title: carragher says two academy kids expose the spending
items.summary:
carragher told cbs the squad is 'very expensive but not as good as it should be and not as balanced as it should be'.
he pointed to ngumoha and nyoni's progress as the thing that makes the £123m barcola and £60m jacquet outlay look badly apportioned.

items.title: liverpool among the clubs watching frankfurt's nnamdi collins
items.summary:
a fussball news report carried by liverpoolfc.com's media watch says united, chelsea and liverpool have scouted the 22-year-old german defender.
it is an aggregator picking up a single german report, so treat it as a watching brief rather than a move.

meta.reliability: low - single fussball news report, reproduced by the club

items.title: wright's hat-trick gives the u19s a 5-3 win in istanbul
items.summary:
liverpool's youth side won the uefa youth league tie 5-3 at fenerbahce, with will wright scoring three.
josh sonni-lambie and finn inglethorpe also scored in wednesday's tie in turkiye.
